messages:
Alex C: Heads up — noticed a spike in schema rejects for /invoke on the payment-tool adapter. Many of the rejects are the tool returning `items: [ ... ]` while our schema expects `items: { ... }`.
Mira P: yep saw that in the alerts at 18:22, console shows a burst but no breakdown of reject reasons. we only have schema_reject_count right now :confused:
Samir: is it user payload or tool output? could be the model variant still returning arrays for list-ish fields.
Alex C: tool output. validator logs show `invalid-type: expected object got array` for `items` but telemetry only reports a generic reject bucket. makes debugging + routing decisions painful.
Jordan (eng-platform): we tag rejects currently with `validator.reason=type_mismatch` but most of that is sampled away at ingest. we should add stable labels: `validator.reject_code` and `validator.field_path`, and emit them at low-cardinality for 1% traffic. that would let the console show top causes without huge cardinality cost.
validator-bot: AUTO: scanned 180 samples for /invoke/payment-tool, 14% invalid-type(items)
Mira P: proposed UX: surface a "Top reject reasons" tile per route + a link to 5 redacted example payloads. rollout as soft-validate on canary so SRE can see impact.
Samir: attaching payload samples triggers privacy concerns. we should only attach anonymized diffs (show structural diff, hash keys) and have an opt-out per-customer. also need retention TTL.
Alex C: agreed. small config proposal for the validator:
```
validator_config:
  emit_labels: true
  sample_policy:
    rate: 0.01
    redact: true
    keep_keys: ["items"]
    retention_seconds: 604800
```
this emits `validator.reject_reason` counters and a sampled `validator.sample` event with redacted payloads.
Jordan (eng-platform): i'll write a short RFC + PR. action items: Jordan -> RFC by EOD, Mira -> mock console tile + tooltip, Samir -> privacy/redaction rules, Alex -> add metric `toolcall.reject_reason` and top-k collector in telemetry pipeline.
Mira P: :thumbsup: adding a quick figma frame and will link it here when ready: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/top-rejects-tile
Alex C: if we can get this in next canary it'll make SLA incident triage way faster. thanks all.
